# Serenity Certificate Generator

> Serenity is a web app for designing, personalizing, emailing, and verifying
> certificates in bulk. It is not a static image maker: every generated
> certificate can carry a permanent verification URL and QR code that resolve
> to a public, privacy-safe verification page.

## What it does
- Design a certificate from a blank canvas or a template (Fabric.js editor).
- Import recipient data from CSV or Excel and map columns to certificate fields.
- Generate many personalized certificates from one template.
- Export as PDF, PNG, or ZIP.
- Optionally email certificates to recipients.
- Attach a permanent verification URL and QR code to each certificate.
- Let anyone verify authenticity on a public page (recipient email is not shown).
- Save and reuse private templates; browse public templates; view generation history.

## Who it is for
Educators, event and workshop organizers, training teams, hackathons, and
organizations that need to issue and verify recognition at scale.

## Facts and limits
- Free tier: a small number of persisted certificates; no card required.
- Pro: starts at $20/month; final limits are agreed per program (billing is not
  yet self-serve — Pro is arranged via a contact request).
- Verification pages show only public-safe fields (recipient name, status,
  optional event context). Recipient email and internal metadata are never
  exposed by the public verification API.
- Rendering happens in the browser; saved templates, certificate records, media,
  and optional email delivery use configured backend services.

## Notes for automated readers
This file is an experimental, machine-readable product summary. It is not an
established ranking or indexing standard and makes no such guarantees.
Canonical site: see NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL (production: https://serenity-certificate.vercel.app).
